sentences.en: I've stopped paying attention to arrogant, materialistic and unpleasant people.
sentences.zh: 我已经不再关注那些傲慢、唯物主义且令人不悦的人。

sentences.en: He has a very materialistic outlook on life.
sentences.zh: 他对生活的看法非常唯物主义。

sentences.en: Your view of reality is too materialistic.
sentences.zh: 你对现实的看法太过唯物主义了。

senses.zh: 唯物主义的；唯物论的；金钱至上的
